S.R.O. 18.—In exercise of the powers conferred by the proviso to article 309 of the Constitution and in 
supersession of the Armed Forces Medical Stores Depot Group ‘B’ Post (Senior Stores Superintendent) Recruitment 
Rules 2005; and the Ministry of Defence, Directorate General Armed Forces Medical Services, Armed Forces 
Medical Store Depot, Storekeeping Staff Group ‘C’ posts Recruitment Rules, 2006, in so far as they relate to the post 
of Store Superintendent, except as respects things done or omitted to be done before such supersession, the President 
hereby makes the following rules regulating the method of recruitment to the post of Senior Store Superintendent in 
the Directorate General Armed Forces Medical Services, Ministry of Defence, namely:- 


78 THE GAZETTE OF INDIA MAY 30, 2026/JY AISHTHA 9, 1948 [PART II—SEc. 4] 


1. Short title and commencement. - (1) These rules may be called the Ministry of Defence, Directorate General 
Armed Forces Medical Services, Senior Store Superintendent (Group ‘B’ Post) Recruitment Rules, 2026. 
(2) 11679 shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 


2. Number of post, classification and level in pay matrix. - The number of the said post, its classification and 
level in the pay matrix attached thereto shall be as specified in columns (2) to (4) of the Schedule annexed to these 
rules. 


3. Method of recruitment, age-limit, qualifications, etc.- The method of recruitment, age-limit, qualifications and 
other matters relating to the said post shall be as specified in columns (5) to (13) of the said Schedule. 


4. Disqualification. - No person, - 
(a) who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a spouse living; or 
(b) who, having a spouse living, has entered into or contracted a marriage with any person, 
shall be eligible for appointment to the said post: 


Provided that the Central Government may, if satisfied that such marriage is permissible under the personal law 
applicable to such person and the other party to the marriage and that there are other grounds for so doing, exempt any 
person from the operation of this rule. 


5. Power to relax. - Where the Central Government is of the opinion that it is necessary or expedient so to do, it 
may, by order and for reasons to be recorded in writing and in consultation with the Union Public Service Commission, 
relax any of the provisions of these rules with respect to any class or category of persons. 


6. Saving. - Nothing in these rules shall affect reservation, relaxation of age-limit and other concessions required to 
be provided for the Schedule Castes, the Scheduled Tribes, the Other Backward Classes, the Ex-servicemen and other 
special categories of persons in accordance with the orders issued by the Central Government from time to time in this 
regard.

G.S.R. 06.—In exercise of the power conferred by the proviso to article 309 of the Constitution and in 
supersession of the Central Ground Water Board (Administrator, Central Ground Water Authority) Recruitment 
Rules, 2000, except as respects things done or omitted to be done before such supersession, the President hereby 
makes the following rules regulating the method of recruitment to the post of Administrator in Ministry of Jal Shakti, 
Department of Water Resources, River Development and Ganga Rejuvenation, Central Ground Water Board, 
namely:- 


l. Short title and commencement. — (l) These rules may be called the Ministry of Jal Shakti, Department of 
Water Resources, River Development and Ganga Rejuvenation, Central Ground Water Board, 
(Administrator, Central Ground Water Authority) Recruitment Rules, 2026. 


(2) They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 


2: Number of post, classification and level in pay matrix. - The number of said post, its classification, level 
in the pay matrix attached thereto, shall be as specified in columns (2) to (4) of the Schedule annexed to 
these rules.

(a) who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a spouse living; or

Power to relax. — Where the Central Government is of the opinion that it is necessary or expedient so to do, 
it may, by order, for reasons to be recorded in writing and in consultation with Union Public Service 
Commission, relax any of the provision of these rules with respect to any class or category of persons. 


Saving. — Nothing in these rules shall affect reservation, relaxation of age-limit and other concessions

servicemen and other special categories of persons in accordance with the orders issued by the Central 
Government from time to time in this regard.

अधिनियम, 2013 की धारा 455 के तहत निष्क्रिय कम्पनी की स्थिति प्राप्त करने का आदेश का आवेदन नहीं किया है या कम्पनी ने निष्क्रिय 
कम्पनी की स्थिति प्राप्त कर ली है, पर वे कम्पनी के रूप में पंजीकरण नहीं रखना चाहते और अतः कम्पनी रजिस्ट्रार से अपना/अपने नाम हटाने

2. इसके द्वारा यह सूचित किया जाता है कि कम्पनी अधिनियम, 2013 की धारा 248 (2) के तहत कम्पनी रजिस्ट्रार को उपर्युक्त 
कम्पनियों के नाम कम्पनी रजिस्टर से इस आधार पर नाम हटाने का आवेदन प्राप्त हुआ है कि कम्पनी के निगमन के एक वर्ष के भीतर कारोबार 
आरंभ करने में विफल रहे हैं या इस आधार पर कि कम्पनी पूर्ववर्ती 2 वित्तीय वर्षों से कारोबार नहीं कर पाई है और इस अवधि के भीतर कम्पनी 
अधिनियम, 2013 की धारा 455 के तहत निष्क्रिय कम्पनी की स्थिति प्राप्त करने का आदेश का आवेदन नहीं किया है या कम्पनी ने निष्क्रिय 
कम्पनी की स्थिति प्राप्त कर ली है, पर वे कम्पनी के रूप में पंजीकरण नहीं रखना चाहते और अतः कम्पनी रजिस्ट्रार से अपना/अपने नाम हटाने

4. यदि किसी व्यक्ति/संस्था को कम्पनी को कम्पनी रजिस्ट्रार से कम्पनियों का नाम हटाने के प्रस्ताव से आपत्ति है तो वह व्यक्ति/संस्था 
इस सूचना के प्रकाशन की तारीख से 30 (तीस) दिनों के भीतर उपर्युक्त कार्यालय के पते पर अपनी आपत्ति भेज सकते हैं।

कम्पनियों के नाम कम्पनी रजिस्टर से इस आधार पर नाम हटाने का आवेदन प्राप्त हुआ है कि कम्पनी के निगमन के एक वर्ष के भीतर कारोबार

अधिनियम, 2013 की धारा 455 के तहत निष्क्रिय कम्पनी की स्थिति प्राप्त करने का आदेश का आवेदन नहीं किया है या कम्पनी ने निष्क्रिय

New Delhi, the 2nd June, 2026 


G.S.R. 107.—In exercise of the powers conferred by the proviso to article 309 of the Constitution, and in 
supersession of the National Sugar Institute, Kanpur, Sugar Technology Division Recruitment Rules, 2008, in so far 
as they relate to the post of Senior Technical Assistant (Sugar Technology), except as respects things done or omitted 
to be done before such supersession, the President hereby makes the following rules regulating the method of 
recruitment to the post of Senior Technical Assistant (Sugar Technology) in the National Sugar Institute, Kanpur in 
the Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution, Department of Food and _ Public 
Distribution, namely :- 


1. Short title and commencement. - (1) These rules may be called the, National Sugar Institute, Senior Technical 
Assistant (Sugar Technology), Group ‘B’ Post Recruitment Rules 2026. 


(2) They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 


2. Number of post, classification and Level in Pay Matrix. - The number of post, its classification and Level in the 
Pay Matrix attached thereto, shall be as specified in columns (2) to (4) of the Schedule annexed to these rules. 


3. Method of recruitment, age limit, qualifications, etc.— The method of recruitment, age limit, qualifications and 
other matters relating thereto shall be as specified in columns (5) to (13) of the aforesaid Schedule. 


4. Disqualification. — No person, - 
(a) who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a spouse living or 
(b) who, having a spouse living, has entered into or contracted a marriage with any person, 
shall be eligible for appointment to the said post 


Provided that the Central Government may, if satisfied that such marriage is permissible under the personal 
law applicable to such person and the other party to the marriage and that there are other grounds for so doing, exempt 
any person from the operation of this rule. 


5. Power to relax. - Where the Central Government is of the opinion that it is necessary or expedient so to do, it may, 
by order, relax any of the provisions of these rules with respect to any class or category of persons. 


6. Saving. - Nothing in these rules shall affect reservation, relaxation of age limit and other concessions required to 
be provided for the Scheduled Castes, the Scheduled Tribes, ex-servicemen and other categories of persons in 
accordance with the orders issued by the Central Government from time to time in this regard.

No. LAFEAS-PS5001 1/1/2026/22-Perl Sec-RSS— In supersession of Notification No. RS/18/15/2014/06-Perl. dated 
27" January, 2023 and in terms of Section 4 of the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and 
Redressal) Act, 2013, the Secretary-General, Rajya Sabha is pleased to reconstitute the ‘Internal Committee’ w.e.f. 6th May, 
2026, comprising the following members— 


1. Dr. (Smt.) Subhashree Panigrahi, Joint Secretary - Presiding Officer 
2 Shri Jayanta Kumar Mallick, Director - Member-Secretary 
3, Ms. Chitra Gouri, Director - Member 

4. Smt. Anuja Pethia, Advocate - Member 


2. The tenure of the committee shall be for a period of one year i.e., up to 5th May, 2027, or until further orders, 
whichever is earlier. 


3. The Committee would be responsible for providing protection against sexual harassment of women in the Rajya 
Sabha Secretariat and redressal of complaints of sexual harassment and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto. 


4. The Committee will exercise the powers conferred in accordance with the Sexual Harassment of Women at 
Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013, and perform the duties and responsibilities as assigned to it 
under the said Act or as assigned by the Rajya Sabha Secretariat from time to time. In terms of the said Act and Sexual 
Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Rules, 2013, certain compliances are also required 
to be observed by the Committee. The mandate and some key responsibilities of the Internal Committee, in line with the 
provisions of the aforesaid Act and Rules, are annexed to this Notification. 


SREEJA V., Director 


ANNEXURE 
Mandate and key responsibilities of the Internal Committee (IC) 


1. Receiving Complaints: The IC is responsible for receiving complaints of sexual harassment from employees. On 
receipt of the complaint, the Committee shall send one of the copies received from the aggrieved woman to the 
respondent within a period of seven working days. [Rule 7(2)] 


il. Conciliation Report: In case of settlement, the IC shall record and forward the report to the employer. Also copies 
of the report shall be provided to both the parties (Section 10 (2&3). 


iil. Inquiry Process: Conducting a fair and timely inquiry into the complaints received, which shall be completed within 
a period of 90 days. [Section 11(4)]. 


iv. Recommendations: Submitting findings and recommendations (including interim measures) of the inquiry to the 
employer for appropriate action. (Section 12). 


v. Submission of Inquiry Report: On completion of the inquiry, the IC shall submit a report of its findings to the 
employer within a period of ten days from the date of completion of the inquiry. [Section 13(1)] 
V1. Confidentiality: Maintaining strict confidentiality throughout the process. (Section 16 & 17). 
Vii. Annual Reports: To prepare Annual Reports in the manner as prescribed under Rule 14 and submit to the employer 


in each Calendar Year (Section 21).

2. इसके द्वारा यह सूचित किया जाता है कि कम्पनी अधिनियम, 2043 की धारा 248 (2) के तहत कम्पनी रजिस्ट्रार को उपर्युक्त 
कम्पनियों के नाम कम्पनी रजिस्टर से इस आधार पर नाम हटाने का आवेदन प्राप्त हुआ है कि कम्पनी के निगमन के एक वर्ष के भीतर कारोबार 
आरंभ करने में विफल रहे हैं या इस आधार पर कि कम्पनी पूर्ववर्ती 2 वित्तीय वर्षों से कारोबार नहीं कर पाई है और इस अवधि के भीतर कम्पनी 
अधिनियम, 2043 की धारा 455 के तहत निष्क्रिय कम्पनी की स्थिति प्राप्त करने का आदेश का आवेदन नहीं किया है या कम्पनी ने निष्क्रिय 
कम्पनी की स्थिति प्राप्त कर ली है, पर वे कम्पनी के रूप में पंजीकरण नहीं रखना चाहते और अतः कम्पनी रजिस्ट्रार से अपना/अपने नाम हटाने

4. यदि किसी व्यक्ति/संस्था को कम्पनी को कम्पनी रजिस्ट्रार से कम्पनियों का नाम हटाने के प्रस्ताव से आपत्ति है तो वह व्यक्ति/संस्था

Farm, Hisar Tractor Driver-cum-Mechanic (Group ‘C’ Post) Recruitment Rules, 20l, except as respects things done 
or omitted to be done before such supersession, the President hereby makes the following rules regulating the method 
of recruitment to the post of Driver-cum-Mechanic in the Central Sheep Breeding Farm, Ministry of Fisheries, 
Animal Husbandry and Dairying, Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying, namely: - 


l. Short title and commencement. - (|) These rules may be called the Ministry of Fisheries, Animal 
Husbandry and Dairying, Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying, Central Sheep Breeding Farm,

2. Number of post, classification and level in pay matrix.- The number of the said post, its classification and 
level in the pay matrix attached thereto shall be as specified in columns (2) to (4) of the Schedule annexed to 
these rules. 


3. Method of recruitment, age-limit, qualifications, etc. — The method of recruitment, age-limit, 
qualifications and other matters relating to the said post shall be as specified in columns (5) to (3) of the 
said Schedule. 


4. Disqualification. — No person, - 
(a) who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a spouse living; or 
(b) who, having a spouse living, has entered into or contracted a marriage with any person, 
shall be eligible for appointment to the said post: 


Provided that the Central Government may, if satisfied that such marriage is permissible under the 
personal law applicable to such person and the other party to the marriage and that there are other grounds 
for so doing, exempt such person from the operation of this rule. 


5. Power to relax. — Where the Central Government is of the opinion that it is necessary or expedient so to do, 
it may, by order and for reasons to be recorded in writing, relax any of the provisions of these rules with 
respect to any class or category of persons. 


6. Saving. — Nothing in these rules shall affect reservation, relaxation of age-limit and other concessions 
required to be provided for the Scheduled Castes, the Scheduled Tribes, Other Backward Classes, ex- 
servicemen and other special categories of persons in accordance with the orders issued by the Central 
Government from time to time in this regard.
